description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bdabowa, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad Map No. 510411
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (No. 0237 of Block 05) with detailed land particulars including ownership details, extent, location, and encumbrances. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns land registration and property ownership matters.
